vintage_status: Current-vintage historical download; not an original-vintage archive.
availability_rule: Retrospective daily quotes assumed usable on next calendar day in Prague; no historical publication-time evidence.
live_quote_policy: BDP PX_LAST may be intraday. Keep separate from BDH ending before pull day.
notes: The prior CZIPITWY Index capture was removed because Bloomberg identifies it as WDA YoY, not a fixed-base level.
CZIPITN Index is the selected replacement and has not yet been pulled; verify Bloomberg metadata before use.

CZGRIDX Index was supplied by the user for Czech building permits; do not assume its unit or cumulative status until BDP metadata and history are checked. Preserve raw observations first; if it is a Jan-to-date cumulative count, difference within calendar year to obtain monthly counts.
LCTQCZI Index is the selected quarterly nominal-ULC input; LCTOCZI Index is retained as an annual benchmark. Neither has been pulled in this snapshot.
EUS3CZ Index is the user-supplied candidate for services demand expectations over the next three months; Bloomberg's month-ahead wording is treated as a legacy label pending BDP verification.
EUB3CZ Index is the user-supplied candidate for construction employment expectations; verify BDP long name, SA flag, balance units, frequency and release timing before use.

GRCPHCPI Index is the user-supplied candidate for Germany all-items HICP. Verify that BDP describes a monthly index level, not a rate or an ex-item aggregate; check coverage back to the paper start and release timing before use.

UMRTDE Index is the user-supplied candidate for the Eurostat Germany unemployment rate, analogous to UMRTCZ Index. Verify total age 15-74, SA percent, monthly frequency and release timing; the paper uses the level (T0).

CZEII Index is the user-supplied candidate for the Czech import-price index. The mnemonic alone is not sufficient: verify that it is the total monthly raw index level (not an import-price rate, export price, terms of trade or trade-flow series) and compare log changes with CZSO before use.

LONSCZNF Index is the user-supplied candidate for the Czech NFC loan balance. Verify outstanding stock versus new lending, Czech-resident NFC coverage, bank/MFI perimeter, CNB inclusion, monthly month-end frequency, nominal level units, seasonal-adjustment status and history before comparing it with the ARAD VST total.
